input.body: We are writing to ask for a review of a deduction on order UE-9a31, dated 2026-11-05. An amount of $24.30 was deducted with the reason given as a missing item, "Honey Drizzle". The order ticket for UE-9a31 lists "Honey Drizzle", which shows the order was prepared as placed [UE-9a31:ticket_lists_item]. The order was ready at 12:28 and was picked up at 12:33, five minutes later, so the handoff to the courier took place after the order was ready [UE-9a31:pickup_handoff]. We recognise that this evidence does not show the contents of the bag, and we are only stating what our records show. Based on these records, we respectfully ask that the deduction be reviewed and reversed. Thank you for your time and consideration.
